description: This Java class handles JSON deserialization and validation for 'fund' commands in the Fineract project, specifically for creating and updating fund entities via API.

classes.name: FundCommandFromApiJsonDeserializer
classes.description: A final class responsible for deserializing and validating JSON input for fund-related API commands in Fineract.

methods.name: validateForCreate
methods.description: Validates JSON input for creating a fund, checking required fields and length constraints.

methods.name: validateForUpdate
methods.description: Validates JSON input for updating a fund, with optional checks for fields if they exist.

methods.name: throwExceptionIfValidationWarningsExist
methods.description: Throws an exception if validation errors are present.
